Task 'CC-006' completed successfully.
[1/3] Fix sorted-inventory slot highlight, comparison badge labels and offline merchant parity

impact_assessment.why: Review of the six unpushed CC-006 commits found a real UI defect: after rarity sorting, selectItem highlights a slot by array position instead of the item's true index, so the wrong slot lights up and the card can disagree with the highlight. Proc stats also render without a percent sign, and the offline merchant fallback omits every new relic.
impact_assessment.benefits: Correct selection feedback under filtering and sorting, clearer stat deltas, and feature parity when the API is unavailable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, client-only behavior; dependency: none, natural JS and Python stdlib; concurrency: none; state: no save format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Headless audit check that fails before the fix, full test suite, Phase 4 gates and multi-viewport inspection

checkpoints.description: Task 'CC-007' completed successfully.
[1/2] Fix mobile layout: single scroll column, unclipped action deck and D-pad, wrapping header

impact_assessment.why: Visual review of the pushed build found real mobile defects: at 390px the viewport panel clipped its own overflow, so only the top 12px of the 7-button action deck was visible and the virtual D-pad was completely hidden; the header's Guide and New Game buttons overflowed 154px past the right edge, creating horizontal scroll.
impact_assessment.benefits: The game is playable on phones again: every tactical action, the D-pad and the whole backpack are reachable in one vertical scroll, with no horizontal overflow.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, CSS-only plus audit checks; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none, no markup or save changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Geometry probe before and after, new headless layout audit checks (deck inside panel, D-pad only when narrow, no horizontal scroll, inventory reachable), full inspection at three viewports and unit suite

checkpoints.description: Task 'CC-008' completed successfully.
[1/4] Lore codex, prologue and Journal panel; then Lost Soul dialogue, sigil-vault objective, boss phases and polish

impact_assessment.why: The game has solid combat and loot but almost no narrative payoff or non-combat interaction: the only story is one-line log text, there is nothing to discover or read, and every floor plays the same way. The user asked for more mechanics, fun, lore, story and interaction.
impact_assessment.benefits: A persistent, unlockable codex gives discoveries meaning and rewards exploration; a branching NPC choice adds role-play and risk/reward; a per-floor sigil-and-vault objective gives each floor a goal beyond the stairs; boss phases make the finale readable and dramatic.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new /api/lore endpoint and extra save fields, both additive; dependency: none, standard library and canvas only; concurrency: unchanged, client-driven; state: save schema grows (loreUnlocked, prop states, sigils) and must stay readable for old saves
impact_assessment.mitigation: Additive defaults on load, Python unit tests for lore and generation, headless audit checks for journal/dialogue/vault and save round-trip, multi-viewport inspection, full gates

checkpoints.description: Task 'CC-009' completed successfully.
[1/2] Review pass: keep every prop reachable (spawn and movement), make the offline fallback carry the new objective, and validate soul choices

impact_assessment.why: Reviewing the CC-009 diff found props can be covered by monsters: random spawns still ignore chests, shrines and urns, and the depth-3 boss escorts ignore every prop (seed 999 places a skeleton on a sigil). The offline fallback has no Lost Soul, sigils or vault, so the new objective disappears when the API is down, and resolveSoul accepts an unknown choice while still consuming the soul.
impact_assessment.benefits: Props stay visible and collectable on every floor, the feature set survives an offline start, and the soul interaction cannot be consumed by an invalid action.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: server spawn placement changes, save schema unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: offline dungeon gains props, and older saves already default them safely
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first spawn/overlap test across seeds and depths, offline fallback audit check in the headless inspector, full suite, gates and three-viewport inspection
